paragraphs.text: Girt with burning-ground garlands, ghouls around, measuring the sense-fields midst shown: Consciousness-Bhairava am I. In You alone, nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, last knower — hence Lord. You alone are worlds’ life: shine in our hearts. Yours, sound-mass-bodied, eightfold-warded, outer circle just; by finest splits and finer, Bhairava, world-lords-led.

It seals all this: total self-form given over, gladdening the devotee-throng, path-joyed, by showing full. Loosed noose-nets, melted marks: Your shape, Lord, seals knowing-wealth of every kind — seal so called. It conquers, supreme-ground-excellent, draught-become: clearly may it dwell, by truth-showing, heart’s known-stain.

Each moment rises knowing; there indeed it flashes below. Know it: the world as Shiva-power-glory-formed, Maheśa’s rite-standers. So in me You flash always — Consciousness-Bhairava, every being’s self — then rite to mantra’s end, complete, effortless, all.
